plugins.name: rolepod-seo
plugins.description: /seo-audit — Quick or Full site audit across SEO (titles, meta, canonicals, robots, sitemap, structured data, internal links, content depth), GEO (E-E-A-T surface, entity clarity, citation-friendly structure, AI-bot crawl policy) and AEO (direct-answer blocks, question headings, FAQ / HowTo / Speakable schema, local signals). Every finding quotes the page and the tag; scores 1–10 per dimension; markdown report + JSON sidecar + Artifact. Calls rolepod-uiproof for rendered-DOM / CWV when installed, hands WordPress writes to rolepod-wplab and copy to the rolepod content-strategist. No MCP server, no hooks.
